question: Rain of Riches (two Treasure on entry; the first spell each turn paid with Treasure mana has cascade) in -- a free spell every turn off the Treasure the deck already makes -- and for what?

contributions.text:
The deck doctor on study 033 (NO CHANGE; only try run, one instrument, 10,000 paired games, Holm-corrected).
What it does: {3}{R}{R}, the 5-6 slot beside Jaws and Fiery Emancipation; two Treasure on entry, then one cascade a turn off Treasure the list already makes. The cascade is a cast, so Valeria, Longshot and the cast triggers see it (a read of the cards, not a proven stack).
What it cascades into: off a typical 4-drop, about 45 nonlands at MV 3 or less (a rough count); about 7 do little off a main-phase cast (Counterspell, Mana Drain, Deflecting Swat, Flawless Maneuver, Shelter, Slip Out the Back, Loran's Escape), nine are mana rocks, and the only wheels in range are Wheel of Fortune and Windfall.
- out Collective Defiance: killed by T6 -0.9 pts [-1.1, -0.7]; finisher wheel by T8 -7.8 pts [-8.3, -7.2]; damage @T10 -2.0 [-4.9, +0.8] no call; hoard @T6 +0.023.
- out Lizard Blades: killed by T6 -1.9 pts [-2.2, -1.6]; damage @T10 -9.9 [-13.3, -6.4]; hoard @T10 +0.43 [+0.25, +0.61].
- out Willie Lumpkin: killed by T6 -0.2 [-0.4, +0.0] no call; damage @T10 -5.9 [-9.0, -2.8]; stall +1.3 pts [+1.0, +1.5]; extra cards -0.9.
- out Jace's Archivist: damage @T10 -38.1 [-42.7, -33.6]; wheels cast -0.67; hoard @T10 -1.92.
Every screen is worse or no call on the early kill; hoard is the one steady gain, and hoard is the resource, not the pressure. Cheapest cut if wanted: Willie Lumpkin. Cannot see: removal on a 5-mana enchantment, the value of a cascaded Swords/Get Lost/Chaos Warp against real threats, protection on a real stack.
